extraction_method: tesseract 4.1.1 OCR on image-only scanned PDF (rendered at 200 DPI) + regex parser. PDF originated as a Microsoft Print To PDF by rick.sutton@hearthnhome.com 2025-09-19.
extraction_note: PDF had no text layer (251 scanned pages). All 251 pages OCR'd. Confidence is good but some long descriptions may be truncated; tier codes normalized from OCR variants (HTL1/HTl1/HT11 -> HTL1, HTI1/HTl1 -> HTI1). Models flagged discontinued = True when "Disc." appears in description. Section/category detection uses top-of-page family keywords with carry-forward across pages. Some accessories may be grouped under the most-recent product family rather than the accessory category itself.
price_field_note: Source price book uses a single "Disc." (dealer) price column. MSRP column was omitted by HHT per cover note: "Please Contact Who You Purchase This Through for MSRP Pricing." All dealer_price values represent Heatilator/HHT DEALER cost (what Benson pays). msrp is null for all models. Tier codes (HTL1/HTI1/HHT1) are Hearth & Home Technologies dealer pricing tiers.
